# @Generated by scripts/in_game/common/generic_actions/gen_tv_victory_tree_node_actions.py
#   Data:    data/victory_path_tree_variant.yaml
#   Regen:   conda run --no-capture-output -n eu5 python scripts/in_game/common/generic_actions/gen_tv_victory_tree_node_actions.py
# Do not edit directly — modify the data file and re-run the generator.
# Click-to-unlock generic actions per node, one per tree node.


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Clicking a node unlocks it directly; `force_click_and_confirm_or_hold`
# makes the engine show its own native confirmation dialog first (see
# reference_game_files/game/in_game/common/generic_actions/readme.txt and
# tatar_yoke.txt/italian_wars.txt for the vanilla precedent). No mod-side
# pending-variable/overlay GUI is needed for this.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Conquest Victory Tree
tv_tree_select_conquest_t1 = {
	type = owncountry
	force_click_and_confirm_or_hold = yes
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	show_message = no
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_variable = tv_conquest_victory_enabled
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_TREE_CONQUEST_T1_POINTS_REQUIREMENT
				var:tv_conquest_tree_points ?= { this >= 10 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_TREE_CONQUEST_T1_NOT_UNLOCKED
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_tree_conquest_t1_unlocked }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			tv_tree_conquest_t1_unlock_effect = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	show_message = no
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_enabled
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_TREE_DIPLOMATIC_B2_1_PREREQUISITE
				has_variable = tv_tree_diplomatic_t1_unlocked
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_TREE_DIPLOMATIC_B2_1_POINTS_REQUIREMENT
				var:tv_diplomatic_tree_points ?= { this >= 15 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_TREE_DIPLOMATIC_B2_1_NOT_UNLOCKED
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_tree_diplomatic_b2_1_unlocked }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			tv_tree_diplomatic_b2_1_unlock_effect = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

# Cultural Victory Tree
tv_tree_select_cultural_t1 = {
	type = owncountry
	force_click_and_confirm_or_hold = yes
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	show_message = no
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_variable = tv_cultural_victory_enabled
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_TREE_CULTURAL_T1_POINTS_REQUIREMENT
				var:tv_cultural_tree_points ?= { this >= 10 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_TREE_CULTURAL_T1_NOT_UNLOCKED
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_tree_cultural_t1_unlocked }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			tv_tree_cultural_t1_unlock_effect = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}
